species.tagline: Eight arms, very good at hiding

tasks.title: Count its arms
tasks.message: Eight arms, each with a row of suckers that grip very tightly.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a webfoot octopus. It has eight arms, each with a row of suckers.

tasks.title: It is very good at hiding
tasks.message: It hides in rock cracks and empty shells, and changes colour to look like a stone.
tasks.subtitle: It hides in cracks and shells, and changes colour to look like a stone.

tasks.title: Help it
tasks.message: A clean sea with places to hide is where it can live.
tasks.subtitle: A clean sea with hiding places is where it lives. Thank you!
